title: RehearsalHandoff
description: Clean, privacy-preserving input contract for voluntary conversation rehearsal in tactical-empathy-simulator.

fictional_counterpart_role.description: Neutral role title (e.g. Cross-functional Plant Lead, Project Sponsor) without personal names.

observable_communication_challenge.description: Observable conflict condition (e.g. resource reallocation refusal, schedule constraint collision).

intended_conversation_outcome.description: Goal sought by the user (e.g. agreement on phased delivery, mutual safety alignment).

selected_development_edge.description: Specific behavioral technique to practice (e.g. dynamic silence, calibrated open questions, mirroring).

known_constraints.description: Facts, deadlines, safety limits, or non-negotiable boundaries.

explicit_unknowns.description: Context or stakeholder parameters not yet known.

prohibited_transfers.description: Privacy and governance lock preventing toxic or biased context transfer.
